notes.title: Update Patch
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41258883/3a680af11fce1a66fb038173a409b53278151b99.png

Hi everyone, we are really glad to announce our new features for Kate: Collateral Damage. 
We think this will make your gameplay more fun and challenging.

Those features are:
- Infinity mode with new leaderboard
- Steam Achievements
- Steam cloud save

Thanks everyone for the feedback on the game, and fill free to let us know what you think of the game and what we can improve it.

notes.title: Future Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41258883/96f6058e0fa37d2410a3b3f3ee865c3c75854ae3.png

Hi everyone, thanks for all the support and feedbacks, we are working on future features for the game that we think it will improve your experience with Kate: Collateral Damage. 
Those features are:
- Infinity mode with new leaderboard, we want to see who among you can last longer
- Achievements
- Badges, cards, emojis and background.
- Steam cloud save

Thanks for sharing your ideas and feel free to give us any feedback.
